시편 20:1.content: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. The Lord hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

시편 20:2.content: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

시편 20:3.content: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

시편 20:4.content: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

시편 20:5.content: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the Lord fulfil all thy petitions.

시편 20:6.content: Now know I that the Lord saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

시편 20:7.content: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the Lord our God.

시편 20:8.content: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

시편 20:9.content: Save, Lord: let the king hear us when we call.
